description: Welcome to NOVALITH! 🚀 We are passionate about space exploration, science, and creativity. Our mission is to bring forgotten space objects back into the spotlight through an engaging educational project. We are looking for motivated teammates interested in space science, research, writing, graphic design, storytelling, and multimedia. No experience is required — just curiosity, creativity, and teamwork!
summary: NOVALITH is an educational digital archive that tells the stories of five pieces of space exploration equipment left on the Moon and Mars: the Lunar Roving Vehicle, ALSEP, Sojourner, Ingenuity, and Ranger 7. Through accessible storytelling, the project presents their missions, technologies, scientific contributions, and final status. It aims to help young space enthusiasts understand that even when a mission ends, its scientific legacy continues. NOVALITH turns forgotten space hardware into stories worth remembering.
details:
NOVALITH is a digital educational archive concept focused on five historical space exploration objects left on the Moon and Mars. It presents each object's mission, technology, scientific achievements, and final status through short, accessible stories.

The selected objects are the Lunar Roving Vehicle, ALSEP, Sojourner, Ingenuity, and Ranger 7. The project aims to make space history engaging for school-age audiences and show how equipment can continue to contribute to science long after its mission ends.

The initial prototype was prepared as a seven-slide presentation. ChatGPT was used for research assistance, drafting, and organizing content, and an AI image-generation tool was used to create the team image. The project is an educational concept that can be expanded into an interactive digital archive.
